name: Curvature-Constrained 2D Gradient Estimation
definition: A refinement of 2D gradient estimation that restricts normal computation to pixels within the same continuous curvature region to prevent blurring across disjoint object boundaries.
summary: Curvature-Constrained 2D Gradient Estimation refines standard 2D gradient estimation by restricting normal computation to pixels within the same continuous curvature region, preventing the blurring of sharp features across disjoint object boundaries.
